description: Split a workflow description into typed steps and produce an orchestration plan and a Mermaid diagram. At design time, to turn a described workflow into steps and a diagram. Do not choose this when you need the workflow executed, which needs the agents. Example requests: Plan the orchestration for this agent workflow. | Turn this workflow into agent steps and a diagram. | Design the multi-agent flow for this process.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

workflow.description: The customer's workflow.txt, as text. Supported: Free text. The workflow in plain language. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_multi_agent_orchestration_plan
title: Multi-agent orchestration plan
